name: Memory Consolidation (Sleep Cycle)
description: Nightly sleep pass: reads the day's notes and log, files what is worth keeping into long-term memory, and writes a short reflection.

payload.message: [Memory Consolidation (Sleep Cycle)] Execute the routine bundled with this job exactly as written; it was passed to you in full. Do the work directly in this isolated cron turn; do NOT spawn another agent. Write the run report the routine requires before finishing. Return only a short delta summary as your final response (max 8 lines).
